description: This Python module provides subtitle text correction and compliance helpers, including grammar/spell corrections, punctuation normalization, entity protection, sentence casing, and OTT line wrapping for subtitles. It includes functions for adjusting subtitle text, wrapping lines, and processing SRT files for compatibility.

methods.name: str _nfkc_normalize(text: str)
methods.description: Performs Unicode NFKC normalization on the input text.

methods.name: str _normalize_spaces(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes whitespace in the text, replacing carriage returns, removing trailing spaces, and collapsing multiple spaces.

methods.name: str _sentence_case(s: str)
methods.description: Converts the first alphabetic character in the string to uppercase, respecting initial non-alphabetic characters.

methods.name: Optional[Callable[[],any]] _load_spacy_model(lang: str)
methods.description: Lazily loads a spaCy language model based on language code, with fallback to blank or None.

methods.name: List[Tuple[str,bool]] _spacy_protect_entities(text: str, nlp_loader: Optional[Callable[[], any]])
methods.description: Segments text into tokens, marking named entities as protected spans to prevent modifications.

methods.name: str _apply_language_tool(text: str, lang: str)
methods.description: Applies grammar and spell correction using language-tool-python, with fallback on failure.

methods.name: str _normalize_punctuation(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes spacing around punctuation marks and dashes for cleaner subtitle text.

methods.name: List[str] _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int, max_lines: int)
methods.description: Greedy word wrapping respecting maximum characters per line and maximum lines, balancing line lengths when possible.

methods.name: str wrap_lines_for_ott(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2)
methods.description: Wraps subtitle cue text into OTT-friendly lines with specified max characters and lines.

methods.name: str correct_subtitle_text( text: str, lang: Optional[str] = None, *, protect_entities: bool = True, sentence_case: bool = True, use_language_tool: bool = True, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2, )
methods.description: Performs comprehensive correction on subtitle text, including normalization, entity protection, sentence casing, grammar correction, punctuation, and OTT line wrapping.

methods.name: str apply_additional_compliance_fixes(path: str, processed_dir: str)
methods.description: Post-processes an SRT file to correct and reformat subtitle cues, saving the result into a specified directory.

ctags.name: _wrap_text
ctags.pattern: /^def _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int, max_lines: int) -> List[str]:$/

ctags.name: correct_subtitle_text
ctags.signature: ( text: str, lang: Optional[str] = None, *, protect_entities: bool = True, sentence_case: bool = True, use_language_tool: bool = True, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2, )

ctags.name: wrap_lines_for_ott
ctags.pattern: /^def wrap_lines_for_ott(text: str, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, max_lines: int = 2) -> str:$/
